description: This source file implements functions for managing and retrieving groups of parameters in a data model, including initialization, destruction, adding parameters, converting to key-value pairs, and getting parameter values either individually or in groups via vendor hooks.

methods.name: GROUP_GET_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a group get vector structure by setting its vector pointer to NULL and entry count to zero.

methods.name: GROUP_GET_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Frees all memory associated with a group get vector, including parameter paths, values, error messages, and the vector itself.

methods.name: GROUP_GET_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a parameter path and group ID to the group get vector, duplicating the path string.

methods.name: GROUP_GET_VECTOR_FindParam
methods.description: Finds the index of a parameter in the group get vector by comparing paths.

methods.name: GROUP_GET_VECTOR_AddParams
methods.description: Adds multiple parameters and their group IDs to the vector, transferring ownership of strings.

methods.name: GROUP_GET_VECTOR_ConvertToKeyValueVector
methods.description: Converts the group get vector into a key-value pair vector, transferring ownership of values and freeing the vector.

methods.name: GROUP_GET_VECTOR_GetValues
methods.description: Retrieves values for all parameters, either individually or in groups via vendor hooks, handling errors accordingly.

methods.name: GetParameterGroup
methods.description: Fetches a chunk of parameters belonging to a specific group using a vendor callback, handling errors and ownership transfer.

methods.name: GetParametersIndividually
methods.description: Retrieves each parameter's value individually, calling either direct data model function or group callback, avoiding recursion.
